paragraphs.text: Jenson Carthalion is a human druid on Dominaria .

Jenson Carthalion is a teenage descendant of Jared Carthalion , and is the newest Elder Druid of the Juniper Order . As a young boy, Jenson was attacked by Dihada's evil forces. He was rescued by a Serra angel and has since incorporated his gratitude into his traditional druidic worship. When the Yavimaya Forest was buckling with the return of the Phyrexians , Jenson did everything in his power to calm it.
